source_snapshot.items: US.1_USB2.0 Interface between HMC and BMC
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; ensure the USB management interface is physically connected to the BMC-side root port; collect evidence and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: The HMC-to-BMC USB 2.0 link enumerates at high speed in dmesg.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 5 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES with usbutils; proposes lsusb topology plus truncated filtered dmesg through insecure sshpass/host-key bypass.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/LOW; read-only checks are automatable but physical topology and stable endpoint/root-port mapping need operator confirmation.

old_problem: A generic high-speed USB message may belong to another device, while software enumeration alone cannot prove the board-level HMC-to-BMC cable route. The proposed regex guessed a bus path, truncated history and used insecure credentials/host verification.
disposition_reason: The test purpose and USB 2.0 high-speed criterion are clear. HMC/BMC endpoint identities, cable/connector and BMC-side root-port path are Project Configuration and physical confirmation under ED-09; they can gate a safe read-only test without keeping review Pending. No cable manipulation is inferred.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2149, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2150 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00027-V002 / 9fc39700bd5d5bf6 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Operator supplies and confirms HMC/BMC endpoints, connector/cable route, BMC-side USB controller/root-port/device path and stable VID:PID/product/serial discriminator.
Use trusted authenticated access with host verification; collect complete untruncated lsusb tree/descriptors, sysfs path/speed and matching kernel/journal events.
Bind the exact device to the approved root-port topology and verify USB 2.0 high speed/480 Mb/s with no reset, disconnect, descriptor or overcurrent errors.
Preserve logs; do not accept unrelated high-speed/SuperSpeed devices, photos alone or USB presence without endpoint/path correlation.
Treat the management cable as service-affecting. Observation is read-only; any insertion/reseat requires separate physical authorization and vendor restoration.
No USB query, SSH, log clearing, cable action, BMC disruption, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove the intended physical HMC-to-BMC USB management link is on the approved BMC-side root-port path and enumerates at USB 2.0 high speed (480 Mb/s) without reset or enumeration errors.
required_package: usbutils and authorized read access to sysfs/kernel or journal
Signed HMC/BMC endpoint, connector/cable and BMC controller/root-port/device-path map
Expected VID:PID/product/serial or equivalent stable discriminator
Trusted authenticated access with host verification
Operator topology confirmation and separate recovery plan for any authorized cable action
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and operator topology confirmation are supplied. Using trusted access, capture complete `lsusb -t`, descriptors, sysfs device path/speed and untruncated matching kernel/journal enumeration. Correlate the approved VID:PID/serial endpoint to the signed BMC root port and verify high-speed/480 Mb/s with no errors. Do not clear logs, guess bus numbers or manipulate the cable.
test_case.expected_result: The exact HMC endpoint is observed through the approved BMC-side controller/root-port/cable path at USB 2.0 high speed/480 Mb/s, with stable descriptors and no reset, disconnect, descriptor, enumeration or overcurrent errors; management connectivity remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires operator-confirmed physical topology plus complete stable-identity software evidence at 480 Mb/s. FAIL on wrong/ambiguous endpoint/path, non-high-speed negotiation, reset/disconnect/descriptor/overcurrent error or lost management link. Missing topology/identity/access is BLOCKED; a generic log line or unrelated high-speed device is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until physical topology and stable endpoint/root-port mapping are signed.
Use secure read-only access and preserve existing logs.
Do not insert/reseat/disconnect the management cable without separate point authorization and restoration plan.
Stop on identity ambiguity, unexpected disconnect/reset, BMC instability or incomplete evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and operator confirmation of HMC/BMC cable/connectors/root port
Stable endpoint VID:PID/product/serial and controller/root-port/device-path identity
Complete timestamped USB tree/descriptors and sysfs speed/path showing high speed or 480 Mb/s
Untruncated matching kernel/journal enumeration with no reset/disconnect/descriptor/overcurrent errors
Unchanged final management-link state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The approved review action is observational. On unexpected disconnect/reset or BMC instability, preserve artifacts and stop; do not reseat automatically. Any separately authorized physical recovery follows the vendor topology/restoration plan and requires confirmation that management service and identity/path return unchanged.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define the HMC-BMC USB2 high-speed path; topology wording is a supplyable project map.

blocked.reason: Review semantics are complete; runtime remains gated on operator-confirmed physical topology, stable endpoint identity and trusted read access.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: HMC/BMC endpoints, cable/connectors, BMC controller/root-port/device path, stable VID:PID/product/serial, accepted 480 Mb/s/error oracle and physical restoration plan.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED USB TOPOLOGY GATE CLOSED; NO USB QUERY, SSH, LOG CLEAR, CABLE ACTION, BMC DISRUPTION, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: HMC/BMC hardware/firmware, board topology and platform management owners
pending.unlock_condition: Bind the signed physical/stable-identity topology and authorize read-only collection; no new review decision is required absent endpoint/path change.

external_authorities.application: Allows parameterized identities, reserves physical cable work for humans and requires complete secure target-bound evidence with preserved logs.

project_authority: Board/HMC/BMC owner supplies physical topology and stable identity; operator confirms cabling; platform owner owns any separately authorized recovery; engineer owns verdict.
